Full Resort & Room Tour: Disney's Contemporary Resort | Walt Disney World
Join us for a complete tour of Disney's Contemporary Resort at Walt Disney World Resort! From iconic Monorail views and convenient access to Magic Kingdom Park to deluxe accommodations, dining, recreation, and Disney Vacation Club villas, we're exploring everything this legendary Disney resort has to offer.

Step inside the stunning Grand Canyon Concourse lobby to admire the resort's artwork and discover transportation options including the walking path to Magic Kingdom, Disney bus transportation, and Monorail access to Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, and other Walt Disney World Resort hotels.

Then, come along as we tour several room types across Disney's Contemporary Resort and Bay Lake Tower, including:

🏰 Theme Park View Room at Disney's Contemporary Resort
✨ 1-Bedroom Club Level Suite with Concierge Lounge Access
🏨 Deluxe Studio at Bay Lake Tower Disney Vacation Club Resort
🌅 3-Bedroom Grand Villa at Bay Lake Tower

We'll also explore the exclusive Club Level lounge amenities, snacks, beverages, and other concierge benefits available to eligible guests.

Beyond the rooms, we'll take you around the resort to experience:

🏊 Feature Pool, waterslide, and children's water play area
🎬 Movies Under the Stars
🏃 Scenic jogging trail around Bay Lake
🍹 Cove Bar and poolside dining
🏖️ Beach recreation area and volleyball court
🌴 Sand Bar snacks and refreshments

Next, discover recreational offerings including:

🚤 Pontoon boat rentals at The Boat Nook
🎆 Specialty fireworks cruises
🎣 Guided bass fishing excursions
💪 Olympiad Fitness Center

Hungry? We'll also visit some of the resort's popular dining locations and shops, including:

🥩 Steakhouse 71
☕ Contemporary Grounds
🍔 Contempo Café
🎭 Chef Mickey's character dining experience
🛍️ Fantasia Market

And of course, no visit to Disney's Contemporary Resort would be complete without watching the iconic Monorails glide directly through the resort!

We'll wrap up our stay with a look at California Grill, featuring incredible rooftop dining, panoramic views of Walt Disney World, and the opportunity to return and watch Magic Kingdom fireworks from the viewing deck with proof of a same-day dining reservation.

Whether you're planning your next Walt Disney World vacation, comparing Disney Resort hotels, considering a Disney Vacation Club stay, or deciding where to stay near Magic Kingdom, this complete resort guide has everything you need to know about Disney's Contemporary Resort and Bay Lake Tower.
